title: Email, calendar, messaging and webhooks
description: Local sinks plus Resend, Google Calendar OAuth, Slack posting, signed inbound events and deduplication.
limitations: Memory webhook dedupe is local; multi-instance deployments need durable atomic reservations.
Calendar supports timed events only; Slack posting needs an application outbox for reliable retries.
